thread.title: Global Protests Driven by Young 'Gen Z' Activists
thread.title_full: Global Protests Driven by Young 'Gen Z' Activists

author: Associated Press Television News
title: Global Protests Driven by Young 'Gen Z' Activists
text:
• A new wave of protests is occurring globally, driven by generational discontent among young people.
• Protests have been reported in countries including Madagascar, Nepal, the Philippines, Indonesia, Kenya, Peru, and Morocco.
• In Madagascar, President Andry Rajoelina was ousted following a military mutiny after weeks of protests by 'Gen Z Madagascar'.
• Protests are primarily led by young people born between 1996 and 2010, known as 'Gen Z'.
• Common grievances include corruption, economic inequality, climate change, and government neglect.
• Protests in Morocco are led by a collective called Gen Z 212, demanding better public services.
• In Peru, protests began over a pension law and expanded to include demands for action against corruption and insecurity.
• In Indonesia, protests over lawmakers' perks and living costs led to the replacement of key ministers.
• A notable protest in Nepal resulted in the resignation of the prime minister in September 2025.
• Protesters in Madagascar cited inspiration from movements in Nepal and Sri Lanka.
• Protests in Madagascar began over utility cuts and escalated to calls for the president's resignation.
• A black flag featuring a skull and crossbones from the anime 'One Piece' has become a symbol of these protests.
• Protesters in various countries, including Peru and Nepal, have displayed this flag during demonstrations.
• In Peru, protests have continued despite the replacement of President Dina Boluarte by interim President José Jerí.
• Digital platforms are being used for mobilization and information sharing among protesters.
• In Nepal, a government ban on social media led to increased use of VPNs and other platforms to organize protests.
• Protesters in Nepal utilized TikTok, Instagram, and Discord to coordinate and highlight political issues.
